about: Hex (hex.pm), the package registry for the Erlang/Elixir/Gleam ecosystem. The CLI searches packages, reads package, release, owner and user metadata from the public JSON API, lists dependents, reads raw release files and shows per-user download stats.

commands.summary: Search Hex packages by keyword, with optional qualifiers (depends:hexpm:<pkg>, build_tool:<tool>), sorting and pagination.

params.name: search
params.description: Search query. Plain keywords match name and description. Qualifiers can be combined with keywords, e.g. 'json build_tool:rebar3' or 'depends:hexpm:jason'.

commands.summary: List packages on the hexpm repository that depend on a given package.

params.name: name
params.description: Package name whose dependents to list

commands.summary: Get package details: description, licenses, links, owners, latest versions, download counts, retirements, security advisories and dependency config snippets.
List all released versions of a package, newest first, with docs availability and publish date.
Get one release of a package: checksum, dependency requirements, build tools, Elixir requirement, publisher, retirement status, downloads and advisories.
List the owners of a package, with ownership level, email and social handles.
Get a Hex user's public profile and the full list of packages they own.
Show per-package download stats for a user's packages: total, yesterday and last 7 days.
Fetch the raw contents of a file inside a package release (e.g. README.md, CHANGELOG.md, mix.exs, lib/...).

params.name: path
params.description: File path inside the release, e.g. README.md, CHANGELOG.md, mix.exs
